name: 저울 추 받침(추 5 — 가장 무거운 납 덩이) (weight stand 5)
label: atlas_biome_interior/plus/weight stand 5
reasons: 화풍: 윤곽이 근흑(재질 어두운 톤 아님) (2/4)

surfaces.part: main lead weight body, top band

answer.evidence: The main body is 12-14 px wide from row 10 to row 29. Rows 10-13 form a mid-gray band (L 66-90) that ends in a lighter 1-row front-edge line at row 14 (L=114, #707080). Row 15 is a dark shadow row (L 31-43), so this is a top band with an edge line and eave shadow (evidence a). A second light line at row 16 starts the front face, which runs dark through rows 17-24, then a brown base at rows 25-28. That gives a front face of about 14 rows. The small handle at rows 6-9 is a detail and not the main body. The darker right edge is shading and not a receding side face.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a dark grey lead weight on a stand. It has 19 distinct colours and a median of 14 per full tile, which sits inside the reference range (hedge 10, cheese stall 17, roofed well 20). Flat-fill coverage is 0%, so there are no dead areas. By eye the lead body steps through about 5 greys, with a lit left edge, a mid body, a dark underside and a top highlight, plus some speckle. The dark edge pixels are 98% near-neutral, so strictly this is a neutral near-black outline. The material is itself neutral grey metal, and the Beodeul lamp-crook reference is also 100% neutral, so the outline is the dark tone of the adjacent material rather than a sticker line around mixed materials. Because the outline is separated by value and the interior shading matches the references, a careful artist would accept it next to them. The weakness is that the outline is slightly heavier than ideal and the surface texture is moderate rather than rich.

surfaces.part: lead weight body top (shoulder plane under the handle)

answer.evidence: The main body has a gray band at rows 10-14 (L 66-90) that ends in a lighter front-edge line at row 14 (#707080). Row 15 is a dark eave-shadow row (#2a2a32). Below it is a front face from row 16 to row 28 (13 rows): a light strap line at row 16, a dark panel at rows 17-23, and a brown base at rows 25-28. The silhouette widens from 12 to 14 px going down, consistent with a sloped shoulder. The handle ring at rows 6-9 is a small detail. There is no receding side face.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small, dark grey lead weight with a ring handle and a stepped base. It has no flat-fill areas (0%), and 14 colours per tile is within the reference range (hedge 10, stall 17, well 20). Its overall palette is only 19 colours, against 38-40 for the stall and well. The body shows about 4 grey steps: a highlight edge, a mid tone, a dark tone and a deep tone. That is fewer than the 5-6 on the references. 98% of the dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline reads as a uniform near-black line around the whole silhouette. The lamp is also neutral, but it is a thin iron piece. The better-shaded references (well, stall, hedge) use tinted dark-material outlines or separate forms by value alone. The weight therefore looks more like a sticker silhouette than the references do. Texture is limited to a few highlight and grain dots on the grey, with no per-facet shading. Since the outline reads as near-black and the shading is shallower than the references, the piece falls short of the Beodeul bar.

answer.evidence: The main body is a weight block 12-14 px wide. Rows 10-13 form a gray top band, and row 14 (L=114, #707080) is a lighter front-edge line. Row 15 is a dark eave shadow (L=31-43), so the top surface is evidence (a). Below it, rows 15-28 (about 14 rows) are the front face, with a second highlight at row 16 and a brown base at rows 25-28. The small handle on rows 6-9 is a minor detail and does not count toward the main body. No receding side face is drawn.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a grey lead-weight block with a ring handle. It has about 5 lightness steps: a highlight edge on the left, light and mid greys, a dark shadow side and a deep base. Its measured numbers are at or above the references: 19 distinct colours (bench 14, lamp 14), 14 colours per full tile (hedge 10, cheese stall 17), and 0% flat-fill coverage. The dark edge pixels are 98% near-neutral, which on its own would read as near_black. The material itself is neutral grey metal, so the outline is the dark tone of the adjacent material, as on the Beodeul iron lamp-crook reference (100% neutral). The outline is not applied as a uniform black sticker line, because the light left edge is separated by value. Texture is modest (a few grain and highlight dots on the lead face) but not flat. A careful artist would accept it beside the lamp and bench without it looking thinner or flatter. It is on the plainer side compared with the well and the stall.

answer.evidence: The main body starts at row 10 with a 4-row band (rows 10-13, L about 66-90). Below that is a front face of about 13 rows (16-28) with a light stripe at row 16, a dark body, a checker trim near row 21 and a brown base at rows 25-28. The handle at rows 6-9 is a small detail. The right edge is slightly darker but is not an isometric side face. The top is a shallow band, so the call is borderline, but it meets evidence (a).

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small lead weight block with a ring handle. It has 14 distinct colours per full tile, which is above prop-hedge (10) and close to prop-stall-cheese (17) and prop-well-roofed (20).
